buyer_added_terms.text: ेेतताा ाारराा जजोोड़ड़ गगईई बबडड कक ववशशेषेष शशतत

1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address ICAR-NIHSAD ANAND NAGAR KOKATA BY PASS BHOPAL MADHYA PRADESH . 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 1 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 7. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 8. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 2 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training,

Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS AND CONDITION:- The firm shall deposit Performance Security equivalent to 5% of the total order value in the fo rm of a Demand Draft (DD) or Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR), drawn in favour of ICAR UNIT NIHS AD, BHOPAL. The Performance Security must be physically submitted within 15 days from the date of award of the contract on GeM or before the supply and installation of the goods at ICA R-NIHSAD, Bhopal, as applicable. The Performance Security shall remain valid for the entire w arranty period of the supplied goods. Bidder Eligibility Criteria. a. Manufacturer Authorization Form The bidder must an OEM of fire spot room prot ective system or shall provide a valid Manufacturer’s Authorisation from the OEM. b. Past Experience: The bidder must have successfully executed at least one similar pr oject related to Supply Installation testing & commissioning of above system(Automatic Room Protection System/ Automatic Tube Based Panel Suppression System)in Governm ent / State/ Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)/Private reputed industries/Hospitals/Instit utions/ IT industries etc, during last 5 financial years (2021-26) c. Turnover: The bidder must have a minimum annual turnover of ₹20 Lakhs in each of the last three (3) financial years (2023-26). d. Local Service Centre: The bidder must have a functional service centre or office in t he Madhya Pradesh to ensure prompt post-installation service and refilling. e. Quality Certification: Clean Agent Fk-5-1-12 must be ULand FM approved. Certifica te should be uploaded with the BID. f. Catalogue: Quotation shall be submitted along with printed technical literature/ cata logue/ datasheet of the quoted make/ model . Scope of Work (Supply + Installation + Testing + Commissi oning). a. Industrial-Grade Hardware: All installation hardware, including brackets, channels, pipe supports, fasteners, anchor bolts, and screws must be corrosion-resistant, heavy-d uty industrial grade (minimum GI or SS-304/316 as per room atmospheric requirements ). b. Vibration and Load Management: Cylinder mounting structures and brackets mus t be engineered to securely withstand the massive kinetic recoil and thrust forces gener ated during a high-pressure gas discharge event. Rubber dampeners and isolation pad s must be utilized where structural vibration could impact sensitive lab instrumentation . c. Designated Placement: The bidder shall execute all civil core-cutting, drilling, and secure structural mounting exclusively at locations officially designated and approved by the NIHSAD Site-In-Charge. Any type of minor civil or repair work shall be under bidd er’s scope. d. Compliance: All physical works must strictly adhere to the Original Equipment Manuf

acturer (OEM) installation manuals, NFPA standards, and national safety protocols. e. Hermetic Sealing: Any wall or ceiling penetration made for piping, conduits, or structural anchoring must be immediate sealed using certified, non-shrinking, non-poro us biological/chemical resistant sealants to preserve the strict negative air pressure diff erentials required by BSL-3 containment protocols. Other Terms & Conditions:- a. All the items shall be quoted as per the technical specifications mentioned. The bidder must mention the make of the items in the compliance sheet/ BOQ. b. The makes mentioned in the technical specification will only be considered for techni cal evaluation. c. The quoted price by the bidder shall explicitly include- The complete cost of the fire s uppression system hardware, electronic components, and extinguishing agents, All logi stics, transit insurance, custom clearances (if applicable), and inside-facility transportat ion to the designated installation zones, Complete end-to-end mechanical installation, e lectrical integration, cross-zoned loop programming, rigorous pneumatic/functional testi ng, and final system commissioning is under the scope of bidder. No hidden or escala tion costs will be entertained post-award of contract. d. Bids shall be submitted along with printed literature/ catalogue of the quoted make/ model of the fire extinguisher. e. Due care is taken to not include financial bid in the Technical bid. Financial bid and Te chnical Bid are two separate documents. f. Only technically suitable bids will be considered for financial evaluation. g. The bidder must provide a comprehensive on-site warranty ofm inimum 24 months (2 year) from the date of successful testing and final handover of the system. h. During the warranty period, any component failure, pressure drop, or system fault mu st be attended to by the bidder within 24 hours of receiving a written/email complaint, at no additional cost to the client (Unlimited breakdown calls). i. During the warranty period the bidder shall make half yearly visit for periodic routine checkup of the entire system. j. Any other material required for successful installation of Fire suppression system like electrical cable, dampers, conduits etc shall be under bidder’s scope. k. Accidental Discharge (False Alarm): If the system discharges during the warranty period due to a false alarm or a faulty detector, the bidder shall bear all costs associate d with refilling and restoring the system to full operational status. l. Discharge Due to Actual Fire: If the system discharges due to an actual fire durin g the warranty period, ICAR-NIHSAD, Bhopal shall bear the cost of refilling and restorati on. However, the refilling work must be carried out by the bidder's trained technicians, who shall subsequently issue an "OK TESTED" certification for the system. m. In the event of any system discharge during the warranty period—whether caused by an accidental false alarm or an actual fire—the bidder shall ensure the entire system is fully restored within 14 days of receiving intimation from ICAR-NIHSAD. n. After successful installation, the bidder must conduct a training session for the staff on how to monitor the system. o. All fire products must be brand new. Refurbished or old stock manufactured more tha n 6 months prior to the bid date will be rejected. p. The contractor will provide all necessary materials, tools, equipment, measuring instr uments and working consumables etc., needed for execution of the works. Safe custod y of all such material will be contractor's sole responsibility. q. OEM Test certificates must be provided for the system.

r. The bidder shall ensure that all technicians use proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and adhere to all the bio-safety guidelines when working inside BSL-3 containme nt laboratory. s. Upon handover, the bidder must provide 2 sets of As-Built Drawings, operation manuals, and conduct a physical training session for the client's security/facility staff r egarding system operation, abort switch usage, and emergency protocols. t. The entire work, including supply, installation, testing, and commissioning, must be completed within 4 to 6 weeks from the date of issue of the Work Order / Letter of Aw ard (LOA). Site Inspection & Estimation of work a. It is strictly mandatory for all interested bidders to visit the installation site/premis es before submitting their financial and technical bids on the GeM Portal. Bids submitted without a prior site visit shall be summarily rejected without any technical ev aluation. b. The bidder must visit the site accompanied by a qualified fire automation technic ian/engineer to thoroughly inspect the physical layout, structural sealing, cable tray r outing, and spatial configurations of the room(s). The bidder must independently asses s and determine: What equipment, how much piping/cabling, and which precise positio ning is required so that the automatic suppression system performs at optimum efficie ncy as per NFPA 2001 standards. c. The financial bid quoted on GeM must be entirely based on the bidder's own on-site t echnical estimation. No claims for extra quantities, additional materials, layout variatio ns, or cost escalations shall be entertained by the Buyer under any circumstances post the award of the contract. d. During the visit, the bidder must fill out the Site Inspection Certificate (as per the f ormat provided in Annexure-1) and get it physically counter-signed and stamped by t he Authorized Officer/Site-In-Charge of the Buyer. A scanned copy of this signed ce rtificate must be mandatorily uploaded along with the Technical Bid on GeM, failing whi ch the bid will be treated as non-responsive and disqualified. . 10.
